get.description: Streams `text/event-stream`. `stream=blocks` (default) emits one `block` event per finalized block; `stream=transactions` emits a `transaction` event with the receipt for each transaction in a block. Event ids are the block height, or `<height>-<index>` for transactions. Resume with `Last-Event-ID` (exclusive) or `from` (inclusive block height). A cursor older than the retained window gets a `cursor_expired` event carrying the earliest usable cursor. Message streams are not emitted until the workspace messaging subsystem exists.

parameters.name: stream
parameters.description: Event stream. `blocks` emits finalized blocks; `transactions` emits receipts.

parameters.name: from
parameters.description: Inclusive block height to replay from; `0` replays the retained window.

parameters.name: Last-Event-ID
parameters.description: Last seen event id; resumes after it and takes precedence over `from`.

200.description: Event stream of `block` or `transaction` events, optionally preceded by `cursor_expired`.

bearerAuth.description: API key from `--api-key` or an RS256 OIDC access token. Keys carry `read`, `write`, and `admin` scopes; a token's `scope` or `scp` claims carry the same names.

mtls.description: Client certificate verified against `--tls-client-ca`. Grants admin operations only; it is not a read/write key.
